run_command: python solution/main.py train --input input --output output && python solution/main.py predict --checkpoint output/checkpoint.pt --input input --output output/reloaded
notes: Fix: the weights loader now walks every string in /models/torchvision/maskrcnn.json and tries (1) it as an absolute or spec-relative local state-dict file (unwrapping model/state_dict/model_state_dict/weights/params wrappers and stripping DataParallel 'module.' prefixes), (2) it as a TorchVision enum member name (COCO_V1/DEFAULT or dotted MaskRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_Weights.* also ResNet50_Weights.* as an ImageNet backbone), (3) the stem plus .pth/.pt/.pkl/.bin/.ckpt/.tar next to the spec and its parent, (4) heuristics on keys like coco/maskrcnn/imagenet/r-50, and finally (5) any solitary weights file found in the spec directory, its parent, or the usual Torch Hub cache directories. Only if all stages fail does it exit with code 78, printing the spec contents and any files it saw. Never falls back to random weights. Training/prediction/doctor behaviour and the benchmark contract are otherwise unchanged.
